description.text: Microbiology is an important basic branch in the life science domain, which studies the laws of microorganisms' biological activities and their connections with nature. With the development of molecular biology, the study of Microbiology has entered the period of molecular biology research, and become one of its important forward disciplines, embodying the general direction. The Doctor of Microbiology program was authorized in 2000. There are 6 research fields, including molecular biological nitrogen fixation and gene engineering, molecular virology and gene engineering, microbial biotechnology, food microbiology, making use of microoganism resources.

duration.text: The Microbiology at Guangxi University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Observe the laws and decrees of China and the regulations of University, and respect the folkways and customs of Chinese. 2.Be in good health. 3.Hold a Master degree diploma or passed the test by Guangxi University.
